info.title: Starship Girl Yamamoto Yohko
info.synopsis: Fra il 1996 ed il 1997, sono state prodotte due serie OAV di tre episodi ciascuna. Successivamente è stata trasmessa in Giappone una serie televisiva anime di ventisei episodi dall’aprile al settembre 1999. La serie televisiva racconta una versione alternativa della storia degli OAV.

info.title: VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream
info.synopsis: Yuki Tanaka è riuscita a essere accettata nella società “Live On” e può così lasciare il suo lavoro e diventare una VTuber. Tuttavia, non riesce a essere tanto popolare quanto le sue colleghe. Un giorno dimentica accidentalmente di terminare una live e tutti scoprono il suo vero carattere. Subito si convince che questo incidente le causerà problemi, ma la differenza abissale tra il personaggio che interpreta e la sua vera personalità ha suscitato l'interesse del pubblico!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: The top-tier VTuber management company in the country, "Live On." Among their third generation talents is Kokorone Awayuki, who struggles to stand out and grow among the countless VTubers.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Awayuki hosts a surprise question-answering stream with her artist and fellow VTuber, followed by an even more surprising karaoke stream.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Now down one working mic, Awayuki drops in on her genmate Chami for a replacement... and also discovers the side of her that she doesn't show on stream.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: While riding the high of her newfound ability to afford games, Awayuki foolishly orders the instrument of pain known as the bane of many a VTuber... the infamous fitness game.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: The time has come at last for Awayuki to witness the debut of Live-On's brand new fourth-generation VTubers! She remains blissfully unaware of what is about to be unleashed upon the virtual world...

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Awayuki's schedule is packed with collabs left and right, from competing in an animal-themed quiz stream hosted by Eirai to presenting the weekly Live-On News with Shion.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Awayuki runs into Kaeru at the Live-On office, learns more about her past, and one thing leads to another... namely a collab with Kaeru and amusement park visit with Chami.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: After an incident at her local supermarket, Awayuki gets even closer to Mashiro offline.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Shion hosts a duo improv competition for her fellow VTubers to test their comedy chops, while Eirai suffers through a horror game stream with Awayuki as her emotional support.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: All members of Live-On participate in a company-wide collab to play Desert Werewolf, a game where they must survive in the desert while dealing with deadly threats both from the environment and from the traitors among them.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Awayuki gets a surprising and exciting call from her manager - and barely has time to process it before she's dragged into another unhinged collab stream as Mashiro and Alice fight for her affection.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Asagiri Hareru's long-awaited concert is here, with her and Awayuki's duet as the finale. Through it, Awayuki finally learns about Hareru's past - and the true nature of the connection that brought them together today.

info.title: Dungeon People
info.synopsis: Clay è stata addestrata dal padre fin dalla giovane età per diventate un membro esperto della gilda dei ladri. Sono passati tre anni dalla scomparsa di quest'ultimo e la ragazza sta usando tutte le abilità imparate per cercarlo in un dungeon pieno di goblin, un minotauro e tante altre creature pericolose. Quando Clay riesce a raggiungere una profondità mai esplorata da nessuno si ritrova davanti il custode del dungeon... che le propone di unirsi allo staff! Ecco l'inizio di un nuovo lavoro che le permetterà di apprendere tutti i retroscena e i meccanismi interni che servono per far funzionare un dungeon.

episodes.title: A Person in the Dungeon
episodes.synopsis: A member of the thieves' guild, Clay ventures into the dungeon in search of her missing father. What she finds is that there’s a lot of work to be done!

episodes.title: Starting Work on the Dungeon
episodes.synopsis: After accepting a position as the dungeon manager, Clay gets the grand tour of the residential quarters in the dungeon. She begins to learn the ropes of the job.

episodes.title: The Ice Wolf's Fangs
episodes.synopsis: Clay and Belle observe a party exploring the seventh floor. When Clay hears that they're fun to fight and grows quite interested, just what will Belle propose?

episodes.title: The Thieves' Guild and the Dungeon
episodes.synopsis: Clay and Belle head to visit the Antomurg Thieves' Guild, where they meet up with the guildmaster Renfringe, and learn of the unique workings of the dungeon of Antomurg.

episodes.title: Coworkers, Family
episodes.synopsis: Clay decides to face off with the massive dragon Reilmond in the arena. She keeps fighting despite sensing her own inexperience in the face of the skilled opponent.

episodes.title: Exploration and Cooking
episodes.synopsis: Despite the abundant ingredients at hand, Clay and Belle are indifferent to cooking. Rangado proposes that they take cooking lessons.

episodes.title: Monster Job Interview
episodes.synopsis: Today's job is a monster interview. Clay is perplexed by the monsters who file in one after another, especially by a monster with a face clearly different from his resume!

episodes.title: Remodeling and Employment
episodes.synopsis: Clay, Belle, and Rangard discuss remodeling the fifth floor. After somehow completing the map with advice from Belle and Rangard, Clay is taken to the dungeon's origin point.

episodes.title: King and Dungeon Master
episodes.synopsis: Belle and Clay head to the castle to take on a challenge. And for some reason, Clay is forced into a maid uniform...

episodes.title: The Wind Slicer's Daughter
episodes.synopsis: Clay is left perplexed when she's suddenly given time off. With time on her hands to think, she realizes she may have a hint leading to her father.

episodes.title: Those Who Are Not Protected
episodes.synopsis: A party of murderers set their sights on the dungeon of Antomurg. To maintain order in the dungeon, Belle and Clay must deal with the rule-breakers.

episodes.title: Dungeon People
episodes.synopsis: Clay grows curious about how the monsters eat so Belle leads her to the hunting grounds. Vast, grassy fields beyond what seems possible to fit inside the dungeon stretch wide.

info.title: Eiyu Kaitai
info.synopsis: La storia è incentrata su un ragazzo di nome Uro Yamada e sulla sua sottoposta, una ragazza di 17 anni di nome Karon. Entrambi lavorano in una specie di agenzia che si occupa di reintegrare eroi da un altro mondo nella vita di tutti i giorni. I due ragazzi vivono insieme e affrontano molti casi, il problema? Karon essendo un ex eroina a volte si lascia prendere la mano dal suo essere eroe e Uro dovrà  fermarla e tenere a bada il suo istinto, cercando di radicare il comportamento della gente comune in lei.

episodes.title: To Kyoto
episodes.synopsis: Making the decision to fight against Shishio, Kenshin leaves Kamiya Dojo and sets off for Kyoto via the Tokaido by himself. Meanwhile, Sanosuke and Yahiko attempt to go to Kyoto to follow Kenshin.

episodes.title: In viaggio sulla Tokaido dell'era Meiji
episodes.synopsis: Rimasta a Tokyo, Megumi incontra Aoshi al dojo Kamiya. Aoshi chiede a Megumi dove sia Kenshin. Quando Megumi cerca di far finta di niente, Aoshi minaccia di ucciderla. Tuttavia, in quel momento appare Saito. Nel frattempo, Kenshin, che si sta dirigendo a Kyoto, incontra una ragazza nella foresta tra le montagne ad Hakone...

episodes.title: Il villaggio abbandonato
episodes.synopsis: Misao è alla ricerca di Aoshi e degli Oniwabanshu. Kenshin è sorpreso di sentire il nome di Aoshi e dei suoi uomini. Vedendo la sua reazione, Misao chiede dove sia Aoshi, ma Kenshin si rifiuta di parlare. A poco a poco, però, i sentimenti di Misao per Aoshi smuovono Kenshin, che alla fine decide di andare con lei a Kyoto.

episodes.title: Portrait of the Ambitious
episodes.synopsis: Kenshin steps into Shingetsu Village, a place where the Mishima brothers escaped from. The village is currently under the control of Senkaku, Shishio’s subordinate, who rules with an iron fist and uses violence to control the villagers. They are frightened of the violence and unable to do anything but obey. The village has decayed and exudes an unusual aura about it. Kenshin heads over to where Shishio is located with Hajime, who’s learned about the current situation and visited the village. In the background of these events, Eiji’s heart burns with the desire for revenge against Senkaku.

episodes.title: To Kyoto, Once More
episodes.synopsis: Kenshin defeats Senkaku and finally faces off against Shishio. However, Shishio expresses his disappointment at Kenshin's policy of refusing to kill and lets his close associate, Sojiro Seta, deal with Kenshin. He leaves the village with another associate of his, Yumi Komagata. To continue his pursuit of Shishio, Kenshin faces off with Sojiro and exchanges blows of Battojutsu, which can make or break the fight's outcome. It is a battle of divine speed from both sides...

episodes.title: Encounter in the Forest
episodes.synopsis: Sanosuke makes his way to Kyoto while trudging through the forest and getting lost at the same time. On the road there, he meets Anji Yukyuzan, a fallen monk currently in training. Sanosuke witnesses Anji unleash an astonishing strike up close, a technique that took Anji 10 years to acquire. There, Anji decides to teach Sanosuke “the Mastery of Two Layers,” an art of destruction. However, he requires Sanosuke to learn the technique within one month; if he fails, he will have to die. Against this unreasonable and excessive condition laid out to him, Sanosuke declares he’ll learn it within a week. The training for this technique, which will make or break his life, begins….

episodes.title: Arrival in Kyoto
episodes.synopsis: Kenshin and Misao arrive in Kyoto, where they’re welcomed by Okina, a grandfather figure to Misao. It turns out, Okina is a former member of the Oniwaban Group. Okina offers his help and Kenshin ask him to help find someone for him.

episodes.title: Cho of the Ten of Swords
episodes.synopsis: Seeking a replacement for his broken sakabato, Kenshin visits Seiku, the son of highly honored swordsmith Shakku Arai, only to learn that he has quit making swords. Respecting Seiku’s philosophy of peace, Kenshin gives up his request for a new blade. Meanwhile, Ten Swords member Hoji Sadojima reports to Shishio on Kenshin’s movements.

episodes.title: Drawing of the Forbidden
episodes.synopsis: Known as “the Sword Hunter” in the Ten Swords organization, Cho is adept at maneuvering a variety of different and unique swords. As for Kenshin, he continues to risk his life and fight for peace in the new era and to save Seiku’s son, Iori, even though he’s forced to fight with a broken sakabato.

episodes.title: Sakabato First Attack
episodes.synopsis: Going back in time, the 4th year of Keio. Kenshin is suffering from a high fever in the main hall of a desolate shrine. Kenshin falls asleep and when he awakens, he finds himself being nursed back to health by former private detective Giichi and his wife Satsuki in their home.

episodes.title: Seijuro Hiko
episodes.synopsis: Kenshin obtains a new sakabato. Having involved Seiku in this conflict, he decides to leave Aoiya before inviting any further danger. Meanwhile, Misao stops by Shirobeko, a beef hot-pot restaurant where Kaoru and Yahiko work part time, where she learns Kaoru is searching for Kenshin.

episodes.title: Meeting of the Warlords
episodes.synopsis: Kenshin reunites with Kaoru and the rest at Seijuro Hiko's place, who is a master of Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu. Seijuro learns from Kaoru that Kenshin goes around the country acting as a rurouni who helps people, when he then decides to pass down the last ultimate technique of the Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu.

episodes.title: Aoshi vs. Okina
episodes.synopsis: Hoji plans an attack of Aoiya at night using a secret unit, the Owl Clan, in order to capture Okina and catch a hint of Kenshin's whereabouts, but instead the Owl Clan were the ones defeated. Okina challenges Aoshi to a battle via a member of the clan whom he sent back to Shishio's location.

episodes.title: Misao's Decision
episodes.synopsis: Aoshi injures Okina, leaves Misao behind, and shows up at Aoiya. He asks the Oniwaban Group where Kenshin is. Aoshi's in a ghastly state, but accepts what Yahiko and Kaoru tell him and decides to wait for Kenshin where Shishio is. Okina is on the verge of death but undergoes treatment by Megumi, who has come rushing to Kyoto.

episodes.title: Between Life and Death
episodes.synopsis: Kenshin undergoes training so that he can learn the ultimate technique. He barely manages to get in a hit against Seijuro in a bout, where he then learns "Kuzuryuusen,"a powerful technique that launches nine slashes at the same time. Kenshin learns to see through Seijuro's swift sword movements and masters "Kuzuryuusen" by looking at it only once. However, the technique was only born out of the process of passing down the ultimate technique, "Amakakeru Ryuu no Hirameki" of Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu.

episodes.title: The Ten Swords Summoned
episodes.synopsis: As a result of passing down the ultimate technique, Seijuro endures a fatal wound.

episodes.title: The Other Objective
episodes.synopsis: Shishio's underlings inconspicuously prepare for their battle plan when patrols arrive causing them to retreat.

episodes.title: As If in Flight
episodes.synopsis: Kenshin and Hajime realize that Shishio has another objective in mind that lies in Osaka. They meet up with Sanosuke there. To stop the Great Kyoto Fire, Kenshin asks for help from everyone at Aoiya via a letter while leaving Ryusaku Arato, the chief of police, in charge of supervising on the ground in Kyoto. Kenshin, Hajime, and Sanosuke head to Osaka Bay on a carriage after they finish their errands. Then, senior police officer, Hikozaemon Omi brings along Juro Kitazawa, a young 11-year-old boy who says he wants to meet with Arato.

episodes.title: The Great Kyoto Fire (1)
episodes.synopsis: It is now midnight. Goichi and the others start moving as it is time to put the Great Kyoto Fire plan into action, when they witness Shishio's other underlings being chased by the police. Henya is annoyed that the fires haven't started on time. Meanwhile, an order is dispatched to the Ten Swords, and they start moving upon hearing their orders. Behind the scenes, Kenshin and the rest arrive at Osaka Bay only to come across something.

episodes.title: The Great Kyoto Fire (2)
episodes.synopsis: Kenshin and Aoshi engage in a battle on the deck of the ironclad Rengoku. Behind the scenes, Sanosuke manages to board the ship and tries to blow up the engine room with the explosives he got from Tsunan. However, Shishio's underlings Hoji, Shuzo, Toshiro prevent him from going any further. Meanwhile in Kyoto, Arato faces off against Kamatari and Henya alone to buy time for the police forces to evacuate.

episodes.title: The Great Kyoto Fire (3)
episodes.synopsis: The engine room of Rengoku. Hoji manages to catch the explosives and prevents the room from blowing up. However, Sanosuke delivers the Mastery of Two Layers to the ship's Kingston valve, flooding the perimeter. Meanwhile, Usui reveals himself to Kaoru, Yahiko, and Misao as Arato faces off against Kamatari and Henya. Goichi begs for Megumi's help at her clinic to heal Tokuji, his younger brother. As these passions clash with each other in all places of Kyoto, a small, over-looked fire begins to flare up.

episodes.title: Tears
episodes.synopsis: In Kyoto, Kaoru quickly notices something strange with Misao, as Misao comes back to the location where a fire was put out. At Megumi's clinic, Omi awakens, bringing tears of relief to Juro. Meanwhile, a black tag is put on Tokuji's toe to mark that he is dead. Kenshin and the others come back to Aoiya, where they learn from Omasu that Okina has woken up.

episodes.title: A Beautiful Night
episodes.synopsis: Shishio sends a dueling challenge directed at Kenshin, Hajime, and Sanosuke. The duel is to be held the next day on Mt. Hiei, northeast half way up the mountain in a small shrine with a six-storied torii. At Shishio's fortress, Hoji proposes a strategy to Shishio for an "absolute victory," when the Ten Swords assemble there.... And on the night before the duel, Kaoru talks to Kenshin as he stares up into the night sky.

info.title: Fate/strange Fake
info.synopsis: La storia ha luogo circa settant'anni dopo la terza guerra per il sacro Graal combattuta a Fuyuki, quando una organizzazione di maghi separata da quella di Londra e con base in America progetta di creare una propria guerra per il possesso del Graal sottraendo informazioni all'associazione inglese. Messo in atto il loro piano nella città di Snowfield, non riescono a riprodurre tutti gli aspetti del rituale: manca infatti all'appello il servant della classe Saber, mentre le altre classi di servant evocati risultano essere dei soggetti decisamente "strani" per via di una insolita impostazione del concetto di eroe.

info.title: Bagi, the Monster of Mighty Nature
info.synopsis: In Sud America, il cacciatore Ryosuke (Ryo) insegue una bestia feroce che terrorizza i villaggi, ma dietro la caccia si cela un passato doloroso: la creatura è Bagi, una gatta geneticamente modificata con DNA umano che Ryo aveva cresciuto come un animale domestico e ritrovato anni dopo come una donna-gatto. Le origini di Bagi risalgono agli esperimenti della madre di Ryo, una scienziata che, per impedire la diffusione di un riso transgenico letale creato accidentalmente in laboratorio, decide di sacrificarsi affidando a Bagi l'ultimo campione da distruggere. Ryo, assistendo alla morte della madre senza conoscerne il contesto, si convince erroneamente che Bagi sia l'assassina e le dà la caccia per anni per vendetta. Quando finalmente la raggiunge nella giungla, Bagi ha ormai perso quasi tutta la sua umanità, ma un ciondolo lasciato dalla scienziata rivela a Ryo l'eroica verità; compreso il tragico malinteso, il giovane rinuncia ai suoi intenti e permette a Bagi di scomparire tra le montagne, sperando che possa finalmente vivere in pace lontano dalla civiltà umana.

info.title: Minami-ke Okawari
info.synopsis: Minami-ke: Okawari, (letteralmente "La famiglia Minami: Secondo"), è la seconda stagione animata della versione televisiva del manga Minami-ke, creato da Coharu Sakuraba nel 2001, e pubblicato dalla Kodansha nello Young Magazine. I 13 episodi della serie, mandati in onda sulla TV Tokyo e su altre emittenti regionali dal gennaio al marzo 2008, raccontano le vicissitudini delle 3 ragazze della famiglia Minami, Chiaki, Kana e Haruka, presenti in originale nel 3Â° e 4Â° tankobon. La serie, diversamente dalla precedente, affidata allo studio DÅmu, è stata affidata allo studio asread, e ciò ha causato una variazione delle animazioni e della grafica dei personaggi. Come la serie precedente, anche questa è andata in onda in esclusiva sulla TV Tokyo e, successivamente, su altre emittenti regionali giapponesi.

episodes.title: Hot Springs, Here We Come!
episodes.synopsis: The Minami sisters, Makoto, Touma, Fujioka, and Takeru go on a hot spring trip for New Years.

episodes.title: Taste is Inherited Over Generations
episodes.synopsis: Kana decides to help her sister become the Great Bancho once more by making the Kana army, but Chiaki on the other hand couldn't help because she considered her friends useless. In the end of the episode they find out Haruka was just refusing a phone call to become class rep.

episodes.title: Evening Hospitality, Secretly an Excuse
episodes.synopsis: Chiaki's classmates invite themselves to the Minami home for a group homework session and sleepover. Kana declares it a 'pyjama festival' and puts herself in charge of hospitality, to Chiaki's annoyance. To feed all her guests, Haruka prepares a family-style nabe meal, and she invites Fujioka and Makoto to dinner. Everyone has a good time, but no-one gets much homework done.

episodes.title: Is It Alright to Tidy Up?
episodes.synopsis: During a routine garbage disposal trip, Haruka encounters a boy of Chiaki's age named Fuyuki who is warmly praised by his neighbors for his willingness to freely volunteer his assistance. It is during this encounter that Fuyuki's participation in the weekend neighborhood clean-up is mentioned. Kana's reluctance to take part prompts Haruka to force her and Chiaki to also participate. Later on, Kana summons a few of her classmates, as well as Chiaki's friends to lighten the workload. During the actual clean-up event, it becomes apparent that the work crew Kana assembled was so that Kana could watch while everybody else does all the work.

episodes.title: Can`t Take Back a Served Tea Cup
episodes.synopsis: Kana and Chiaki break a glass rabbit necklace that Haruka had bought. Worried that the rabbit was a gift to Haruka that she treasures, both Kana and Chiaki try to repair the rabbit. After the repairs go badly, Kana tries to get Fujioka, Keiko, and Yoshino to look for another to replace the broken rabbit. In the end, Haruka discovers the truth.

episodes.title: Has My Rice Already Cooled Down?
episodes.synopsis: The power goes out and the Minami sisters invite Fuyuki over.

episodes.title: The More You Chew It, The Sweeter It Becomes
episodes.synopsis: It's Valentines Day and the Minami sisters are making chocolates to give out. Kana tries to eat Fujioka's chocolates, but he tries to keep them a secret from her, hoping that Kana will give him chocolate.

episodes.title: There`s Always Time for the Pool
episodes.synopsis: A local shop owner gives Haruka tickets to a new indoor pool. We learn that Chiaki doesn't know how to swim and doesn't want the others to find out. Later, Kana tries to teach Chiaki how to swim and help Chiaki meet her goal to swim 100 meters. Haruka sleeps the entire time, trying to ignore her sisters, until her highschool friends throw her into the pool.

episodes.title: Starting to be Painful? The Secret of Mako-chan
episodes.synopsis: Kana believes she has prophetic dreams and can predict the next nights dinner. Makoto is almost caught crossdressing by Yoshino, and Kana worries whether she is a bad influence on Makoto. Haruka is told that she has been selected to study abroad and is having a hard time with the prospect of leaving.

episodes.title: `Dumplings Rather Than Flowers` Age
episodes.synopsis: Spring has sprung and the Minami sisters are sitting around the kotatsu talking. Chiaki confuses 'skirt steak' (harami) with 'flower viewing' (hanami) and is teased by Kana. To save Chiaki, Haruka suggests going flower viewing, though it is still too early.

episodes.title: It became bad as expected
episodes.synopsis: Toma's secret is almost revealed to Fujioka when he sees her in a girls uniform. Kana covers for her by making Fujioka believe that everyone must crossdress at her place and tries to force Fujioka to comply. Kana feigns a cold on Saturday to avoid doing the city cleanup; Chiaki stays to keep an eye on Kana and figures out she was faking. The next day, she truly catches a cold and tries to avoid being found out, all the while recruiting Uchida and Mako-chan for help.

episodes.title: One More Mouthful is Painful
episodes.synopsis: Chiaki helps to prepare for a school sports meet. Meanwhile, the sisters learn that Fuyuki is moving and is forced to leave in the middle of the sports meet. Kana learns that Haruka has been selected to study abroad.

episodes.title: Everyone Gather, Thanks for the Meal
episodes.synopsis: Frightened of the prospect of Haruka studying abroad, Kana and Chiaki decide to step up to the plate and exert more of an effort with the cooking and cleaning as well as the other domestic chores in order to put Haruka's mind at ease after sending her off with a smile. It quickly becomes evident that the prospect of having to actually take care of themselves in Haruka's absence is much more than Kana and Chiaki can endure. While being tearfully embraced and exhorted to stay with them, Haruka explains to Kana and Chiaki that she has no intention of studying abroad anyway.

Ad aver subito i maggiori danni è indubbiamente Amuro, l'unico a combattere sempre in prima fila col Gundam; Amuro fatica a dormire, è stanco di combattere e di uccidere, e l'incontro con la madre l'ha lasciato confuso e smarrito. Iniziano inoltre a diffondersi le voci sui cosiddetti newtype, esper dalle superiori capacità cognitive che gli scienziati di Zeon teorizzano essere il successivo passo evolutivo della razza umana dopo il suo adattamento allo spazio; e gira voce che Amuro possa essere uno di questi, a causa dei suoi incredibili risultati a bordo del Gundam nelle battaglie finora affrontate.

episodes.synopsis:
The Federation space ship White Base and its precious cargo of prototype mobile suits have returned to Earth, only to find themselves in enemy territory. As the White Base struggles across the planet's surface to safety, Gundam pilot Amuro Ray must contend not only with the Principality of Zeon's fiercest warriors, but also with his own doubts and fears.

info.title: Daltanious il robot del futuro (ITA)
info.synopsis: Nel 1995 la Terra viene attaccata da invasori alieni e la guerra che ne deriva causa morte e povertà in tutto il Giappone. Kento è il capo di un gruppo di ragazzi che fa di tutto per garantire la sopravvivenza dei suoi amici, ricorrendo a qualsiasi espediente e rubando anche il cibo, se necessario. Un giorno Kento trova e attiva una misteriosa astronave e conosce il Dr. Earl, alieno proveniente dal pianeta Helios, che tempo prima era stato invaso e distrutto dagli stessi invasori che ora minacciano la Terra. L'unica speranza di salvare la Terra risiede nel principe del suo pianeta e nel potente Daltanious, di cui tuttavia il Dr. Earl ha perso le tracce durante l'atterraggio sulla Terra...

episodes.title: Ribellione
episodes.synopsis: Kento and Dani face the Akron in the second battle where triumphants leave but a marching robot army based on Dr. Earl ready for revenge. The professor tells the boys about his exile of space, when he left the planet Helios invaded by Akron to take refuge in the Earth. He came to our planet in 1945 along with the Harlin prince whose traces are lost together with the robot lion made by the professor to face the enemy in the future.

episodes.title: Terrore dal cielo
episodes.synopsis: The enemies are preparing to finally invade the Earth; Meanwhile, the base is looking for a way to recover Beralios, the lion robot dispersed during the landing of Dr. Earl at World War II.

episodes.title: Il ritorno di Beralios
episodes.synopsis: Kento, built his royal origin, settles in the imperial rooms of the base while his friends are confined to some secondary rooms, with remarkable envy towards his friend.Suddenly a gigantic statue of the Emperor Nishimura, grandfather of Kento, plunged into the city.

episodes.title: Il ritorno di Beralios
episodes.synopsis: Kento, built his royal origin, settles in the imperial rooms of the base while his friends are confined to some secondary rooms, with remarkable envy towards his friend.Suddenly a gigantic statue of the Emperor Nishimura, grandfather of Kento, plunged into the city.

episodes.title: Gli ostaggi
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Earl puts pressure on Kento's friends to persuade Helios to live as he fits at the base and to face the necessary training.The boy, infuriated by the attitude of his comrades, decides to escape to retire to lonely life.

episodes.title: Gamerot
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Earl supports Manabu's desire for knowledge, which together with Jiro and Tanosuke builds Gamerot, a sort of mechanical battle tortoise. Meanwhile, the Akron attacked with a ship deployment and a terrible mechanical monster.

episodes.title: Il Generale Herman
episodes.synopsis:
A military delegation goes to visit Dr. Earl's base in order to build an alliance against invading enemies.
General Herman intentions are to put the installation under control and militarize the area to make it a garrison of the terrestrial army.

episodes.title: Perfida
episodes.synopsis: A woman appears who want to adopt Ochame. Actually she is an Akron creature who have the directive of General Nesia to kidnap the girl.

episodes.title: Nelle fauci del mostro
episodes.synopsis: Jiro meet a boy who is looking for his mother. In his jealousy, he gives him false information. Thus the boys mother gets into the middle of a fight. Jiro apologizes and helps him to reunite with his mother.

episodes.title: Tragico destino
episodes.synopsis: A group of motorcycle rowdys is attacking Sanae. Dani follows their tracks and meets his former cellmate turned gang leader, Saburo.

episodes.title: La prova del fuoco
episodes.synopsis: Jiro and Tanosuke  quarrel, and both ask Kento for fighting lessons. During the fight Kento thinks of his childhood and the lessons he received by his  beloved grandfather Kanto.

episodes.title: Sanae in pericolo
episodes.synopsis: During tidying up,  Sanae contracts an alien virus, and it’s up to the others to help cure Sanae before she succumbs to the virus.

episodes.title: Tanosuke si innamora
episodes.synopsis: Tanosuke Hata meets a young girl named Ayame Sujita, and cupid’s arrow makes its strike. However, he does not know that his heart is already busy.

episodes.title: Un`amicizia
episodes.synopsis: General Mitsuka, one of Kloppen’s generals, decides to pignap Jiro’s pig Tonsuke and use him as a weapon against our heroes.

episodes.title: Una festa indimenticabile
episodes.synopsis: Manabu restores electricity in the city that has been ravaged by the Akron Empire’s attacks. The townfolk organize a festival to celebrate the event. The appearance of an enemy robot ruins everything.

episodes.title: Il tranello
episodes.synopsis: General Neshia really sinks to a new low by sending the hungry orphans a huge batch of food… all of which is poisoned.  If only Tanosuke would resist temptation and not eat that poisoned apple…

episodes.title: Il suono delle campane
episodes.synopsis: A new school opened up in town, and Ochame wants to go.  Too bad those damn aliens have other plans…

episodes.title: Un colpo di fulmine
episodes.synopsis: In this episode, a thief has hit the market… a young girl named Kaori Inoue. Once again, Tanosuke falls in love.

episodes.title: Il maestro
episodes.synopsis: This episode shows a robot under the disguise of a cicada that tries to infiltrate Doctor Earl’s space station from the inside. Unfortunately, a child named Kenichi, who enjoys collecting bugs, puts a wrench in the general’s plans.

episodes.title: L`invasione delle stelle marine
episodes.synopsis: Supreme General Kloppen is becoming frustrated that his generals have been failing every time they unleash their attacks on Earth. General Mitsuka decides to attack using an unusual weapon… starfish. Yes, you read right… starfish!

episodes.title: Cratus il guerriero dello spazio
episodes.synopsis: Doctor Earl and the seven orphans are greeted by Cratus, a legendary space warrior from Helios. Cratus brings news that throughout space, the Akron Empire has been losing ground because of the news of Prince Kento’s existence.

episodes.title: Il robot professore
episodes.synopsis: Doctor Earl has become fed up of Kento Tate skipping on his “lessons”, so he constructs an instructor robot to make sure Kento doesn’t play hookey anymore.

episodes.title: La tigre dello spazio
episodes.synopsis: In this episode, we meet a friend of Cratus, “Gascon, Tiger of the Galaxy”.  Gascon is one of the most feared and courageous warriors in the galaxy, according to Doctor Earl.  He is also about as crude and foul-mouthed as Kento.  But anyway, he’s neutral in the war between Daltanious and the Akron Empire.  Which side shall he go to in this war?

episodes.title: L`inganno
episodes.synopsis: After so many years, Beralios is reunited with Meralian, his long lost lover whom was believed to be deceased.  Unfortunately, Meralian had been imprisoned by General Mitsuka and is eventually used as bait to destroy Beralios.

episodes.title: Il perdono di Danji
episodes.synopsis: Danji finds the man who set up his father for murder which led to the execution of Danji’s father.  Will Danji finally be vindicated once and for all?

episodes.title: Faccia a faccia
episodes.synopsis: If you thought Kloppen was the head honcho of Zaar, think again!  He answers to Zaar’s emperor, Grand Emperor Ormen.  After seeing Kloppen getting his ass kicked, he’s getting pissed off.  Kloppen tries to calm his enraged emperor by assuring that victory against Daltanious will be guaranteed.

episodes.title: Un folle rischio
episodes.synopsis: Continua la battaglia di Daltanious contro il popolo invasore degli Akron, che vuole conquistare la Terra. Il robot subisce ingenti danni durante un combattimento.

episodes.title: Attacco sulla Luna
episodes.synopsis: Daltanious, Kento e Danji sono costretti a lasciare la terra per cercare il quartier generale stabilito da Kloppen sul lato oscuro della Luna.

episodes.title: Operazione energia
episodes.synopsis: This is the episode where Daltanious finally gets a major upgrade after Zaar sends its newest type of monster on Earth… a twinborg! Unfortunately, Unitogeros, the first of the twinborgs, prove to be too powerful for Daltanious… going as far as to neutralize the Flame Sword!  So what does Doctor Earl and company do?

episodes.title: La principessa Florinda
episodes.synopsis: Here comes the bride!  Here comes the… WHAT THE HELL?! When did Kento get married and who the hell is… Oh, yeah!  It’s Princess Kyatinu of Planet Proxia. This princess from outer space wants to marry Kento so that she can become an empress to Helios.

episodes.title: Un incontro importante
episodes.synopsis: This time, we have one heck of a bombshell.  Kento and a new character named Hayato re-enact a scene from Star Wars… sort of.

episodes.title: La storia del principe Harlin
episodes.synopsis: We see more of Marios, the same man who survived the plane crash … and Ormen wants to know what he knows.  I wonder what secrets he could be hiding?

episodes.title: Chi è Kloppen
episodes.synopsis: Ormen sees that he’s losing ground as the resistance against his empire is growing exponentially.  Therefore, he comes with a scheme which involves Kloppen removing his mask.

episodes.title: Il perdono del guerriero
episodes.synopsis: Princess Kyatinu and her nurse, Lady Judela decide to leave Earth as they see Kento as a worthless clone’s spawn.

episodes.title: Tradimento
episodes.synopsis: Doctor Earl has been accused of being a traitor to the Empire of Helios… by Kloppen?!  What the hell is that all about?!

episodes.title: Trattato di pace
episodes.synopsis: Inaspettatamente, gli Akron propongono ai terrestri di firmare un trattato di pace. Ci sarà da fidarsi?

episodes.title: La nave maledetta
episodes.synopsis: Kento Tate acts as if he wants to bump uglies even though he might be infected with “The Clap“.

episodes.title: Il ritorno di Harlin
episodes.synopsis: Kento non ha più alcun dubbio: Harlin, suo padre, è ancora vivo, e il ragazzo intende trovarlo.

episodes.title: I disertori
episodes.synopsis: Kento is so excited that he has his father back in his life again after being absent for twelve years. And as for the Empire of Zaar, they demonstrate their cruelty even to their own kind by forcing their own men to kill Hayato Tat… err, I mean Prince Arlin… or their own families would be slaughtered.

episodes.title: Il segreto di Namel
episodes.synopsis: Namil returns… only to be killed off by Kloppen by direct orders from Grand Emperor Ormen.  However, before he cursed them out, he reveals what is known as “The Secrets of Zaar”.

episodes.title: Kloppen in crisi
episodes.synopsis: Now that the whole universe sees Kloppen as a clone,  Kloppen is shunned by everyone in Zaar… even his own imperial guard! Kloppen’s former imperial guard decide to declare mutiny against him and deliver their former commander as a gift to Prince Arlin.

episodes.title: Una trappola per Kloppen
episodes.synopsis: While Kloppen is thinking of what Kento had said in the previous episode, he’s faced with being between a rock and a hard place.  According to Ormen, he has to kill Prince Arlin and regain his position in Zaar or face the bleak future of working in a factory until the end of his days.

episodes.title: Impresa eroica
episodes.synopsis: Il Principe Arlin decide di partire con la base e Daltanious per distruggere gli Akron, ma prima deve sconfiggere il loro quartier generale.

episodes.title: Viaggio nel cosmo
episodes.synopsis: It’s time for Adarus Base to go out into space and launch its attack on the Army of Zaar!  It looks like the death of Emperor Parumion (no, not Emperor Nishimura) will finally be avenged…

episodes.title: In lotta contro la morte
episodes.synopsis: Prince Arlin was mortally wounded by a sneak attack from the late General Mitsuka. Worse yet, Kloppen was mortally wounded as well by General Kabuto.  After overhearing Kento shedding tears for this one man responsible for murdering his mother and sister (and countless millions on Earth), Kloppen is moved enough to make the ultimate sacrifice so that Kento’s father has a chance at survival.

episodes.title: Alla conquista di Zaar
episodes.synopsis: Despite Prince Arlin has yet to regain consciousness from receiving Kloppen’s organs, Arlin is brought with Kento and company so that he would be there when the war goes on.  After vanquishing Supreme General Neshia, is a regular war ensemble!  As a fight with Ormen on an unnamed twinborg unwinds, the Emperor of Zaar finally reveals his face!

episodes.title: La tragedia di Ormen
episodes.synopsis: Ormen shows his true face and regales to everyone in shocking detail of how the clones were conceived and how they were used as insurance for the Helios Royal Family.  Apparently, the Empire of Helios is not as noble as it has been made out to be since the very beginning.

episodes.title: Nice to Meet You, Master!
episodes.synopsis: Naeka is a seventeen year old girl who will inherit a large fortune when she turns eighteen, however, many people might try to assassinate her and take the fortune, so her rich grandfather sends two maids, Kogarashi and Fubuki to act as her and her brother's bodyguards.

episodes.title: The Expert on Beloved Huge Breasts
episodes.synopsis: When Naeka discovers that the reason she's failing math is because her enormous breasts are taking away nutrients from her brain, she, her brother, Fubuki and Kogarashi try to find different ways of making her chest flatter.

episodes.title: The Romantic Won`t Stop?

Soon enough, her friends and family find out that she's not interested in love due to her first crush hating her because she nearly poisoned him. So her friends and family decide to help her overcome this incident by teaching her how to cook. Meanwhile Kogarashi is setting up a romantic setting for her and the other person, which he laces full of aphrodisiac gas to make sure all goes well. When Naeka goes to the place where she is supposed to meet the person, she finds out it is a girl! Kogarashi, still thinking his plan is good, locks both of them in there. episodes.title: Thongs and Big Breasts

episodes.title: Maid Ninja Arts, High School Girl`s Technique

episodes.title: The Clumsy Maid Won`t Turn Around

episodes.title: Naeka`s Sword, Kuramayama Training Chapter
episodes.synopsis: Naeka prepares for the upcoming kendo tournament and is helped in training by her brother, Fubuki, and Kogarashi. However, the odds are against her when she is fixed against a huge adversary and when Elizabeth tries to sabotage her fights.

episodes.title: His Name Is Wonder Man! Strawberry Mask

However, Elizabeth, not wanting her brother to marry her nemesis, disguises herself as the Strawberry Mask (even though people know who she is) to try to stop Hendrick from making Naeka fall in love with him because she actually wants him for herself.

episodes.title: Sweet Service In the Cleavage

Eiko and Miwa also ask Naeka and Fubuki, who have D-cup breasts, to infiltrate their cake shop's rival shop, which has terrible cakes, but all waitresses have huge D-cup breasts. episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: The movie takes place between episodes 36 and 37 of the TV series. Now that Mephisto has been freed from Noise's evil influence, he pays a visit to Ako with the intention of bringing her back to Major Land to live with her parents again. Ako, who misses her parents, agrees, but before they can leave, all the music suddenly disappears from Kanon Town. Upon arriving in Major Land where people are forced to play with no music coming out, Mephisto, Ako, and the other PreCure encounter Ako's childhood friend, Suzu, who claims that Aphrodite is allegedly responsible for stealing the world's music. As Hibiki, Kanade and Ellen escort Suzu to her home, Ako and Mephisto confront Aphrodite, who captures Ako and sends three servants called the Major Three after the others to try to obtain the Healing Chest. As they send a Negatone after the Cures, Suzu escapes with the Healing Chest. As the others struggle against the Major Three, Mephisto helps to free Ako by singing her favourite song, helping everyone realise music that comes from the heart and allowing the Cures to defeat the Major Three. Aphrodite reveals she is being possessed by an evil known as Howling, becoming willing to sacrifice herself so that Howling can be destroyed with her. Not willing to kill Aphrodite, Mephisto forces Howling to leave Aphrodite's body. As Howling overwhelms the PreCure, Suzu and the other citizens use their power to help them, restoring everyone to normal. Howling transforms into his true form and captures Kanade, Hibiki's unwillingness to give up grants her the power to become Crescendo Cure Melody and together with the others manages to defeat Howling. Afterwards, Ako decides to stay in Kanon Town with the other PreCures.

episodes.title: My Life Might Be Over
episodes.synopsis: Akane Tsuda (28), who works in the product planning department of a major electronics manufacturer, has a smooth career and is well-liked by her colleagues. However, her personal life is a disaster! Her room is a complete mess, and she has terrible drinking habits. In a drunken stupor, she impulsively buys a household robot. Later, what arrives at her doorstep is none other than an adult-use android named Nadeshiko...?

episodes.title: Nothing's Okay...
episodes.synopsis: Akane sighs as she heads home earlier than usual. And no wonder—since the other day, an illegal adult robot named “Nadeshiko” has been staying at her house! Since Nadeshiko, who just arrived, doesn't have any underwear, the two head out to buy some together. Once they do, Nadeshiko goes to change in the bathroom, but she doesn't come back for a while...?

episodes.title: The Power Switch is Inside the Mouth...!?
episodes.synopsis: Akane jolts awake from a nightmare where her workplace discovers she'd bought an illegal romance robot named Nadeshiko. The very source of her worries, Nadeshiko, was apparently sleeping soundly right beside her. Hmm? Come to think of it, robots don't sleep, do they? Is she out of battery? As Akane thinks this, she manages to charge Nadeshiko safely, but then she couldn't figure out how to restart her...?

episodes.title: Name-Calling is Bad for the Heart!
episodes.synopsis: Seeing Akane exhausted from her grueling work, Nadeshiko offers her a regular massage. Following that, Nadeshiko asks Akane to perform the “Master Authentication,” but Akane refuses the request. Master Authentication means becoming Nadeshiko's owner, but Akane says Nadeshiko feels too human to be treated like a tool. How will Nadeshiko reply when Akane tells her she wants to start as friends first...?

episodes.title: Regarding Nadeshiko Being Too High-Functioning
episodes.synopsis: Akane is on her way home. Troubled by how deeply she's becoming bound to Nadeshiko, unlike before, Akane feels grateful that the lights are on at her house, that someone is there waiting for her. And the one who greeted Akane upon her return was Nadeshiko... wearing nothing but an apron?

episodes.title: I, Akane, will Crash the Owner Get-Together!
episodes.synopsis: Akane gets an invite to an anonymous online get-together exclusively for Romanceroid owners. Though uneasy about the anonymous email, she decides to attend, thinking it might reveal Nadeshiko's secret. What awaited Akane, filled with apprehension, was a gathering of owners dressed in fairy-tale-like animal costumes—a dog, a rabbit, a bear...?

episodes.title: Huh, Nadeshiko has a Mother?
episodes.synopsis: Akane (and Nadeshiko, who came along out of concern) stays at a leisure hotel during a business trip. While enjoying the large bath, big bed, and stylish meals unique to leisure hotels, Akane braces herself for “that sort of thing” with Nadeshiko... but nothing happened at all! Still feeling frustrated that nothing had happened, Akane drifts off to sleep, when suddenly, she hears the TV on...?

episodes.title: I'm Not a Baby!!!
episodes.synopsis: One day after consecutive overtime shifts, Nadeshiko worries about Akane, who comes home late as usual. But before Akane could even reply, she collapses at the front door. Even though she woke up, Akane had regressed to infancy (?) due to exhaustion. Nadeshiko tries every trick in the book to nurse her back to health. However, mistaking Nadeshiko for her own mother, Akane begins acting clingy toward her...

episodes.synopsis: Ryosuke Kamiya, a third-year college student, is paired up for a presentation with Ruka Someya, a classmate from his seminar whom he secretly finds cute. His joy is short-lived, however, as Ruka—claiming she's too busy with her part-time job—proves to be no help at all, leaving him to prepare for the presentation almost entirely on his own… While working at home, Ryosuke loses his concentration and starts browsing an adult video streaming site, only to be stunned by the sight of a sexy actress who looks exactly like Ruka…?!

episodes.title: Let Me Stay Here
episodes.synopsis: Ryosuke tries to apologize again for what happened last night, but Ruka blackmails him with footage she'd secretly taken of him completely naked in his sleep. Her demand was that she be allowed to live in Ryosuke's spacious apartment. An unlikely living arrangement begins between a dull college guy and a sexy gyaru film star! The two start off with the shopping to get ready for their new life together. On the way back, Ruka brings up something that takes Ryosuke a bit by surprise…

episodes.title: This Really... Turns Me On
episodes.synopsis: Ryosuke's innocent question about situation-based adult films leads them to explore an old, disused university club building. Ryosuke and Ruka wander through the abandoned clubroom. It's a thrilling situation where they're all alone in a place where no one is likely to come, yet they might just get caught by someone! Ruka looks exasperated at Ryosuke, who can't help but get excited at the thought…

episodes.title: I'm Doing My Best, Okay?!
episodes.synopsis: Ruka has gone out for a shoot. Ryosuke understands the logic that filming is just part of the job for an active adult film actress… yet the unease in his heart won't fade. He knows he shouldn't watch, but he can't take his eyes off Ruka in the video, and his unease only grows. When night falls and Ruka returns home after finishing her shoot, Ryosuke—who's been lost in thought all day—is exhausted and gaunt. This has Ruka worried, but unusually for Ryosuke, he initiates sex with her…

episodes.title: I Love Someya-san
episodes.synopsis: Having realized his feelings for Ruka, Ryosuke musters his courage and asks her out on a date to the aquarium. Though he still couldn't bring himself to confess his feelings, Ryosuke was able to enjoy the day off with Ruka. On the way home, they stop at a family restaurant, and the conversation eventually turns to Ruka's family. Ryosuke then discovers that her family was connected to the reason she became a sexy actress…

episodes.title: I Have Something To Show You!
episodes.synopsis: Winter arrives. Students in recruitment suits become a common sight on campus. Seeing them, Ryosuke, now conscious of the job hunt, asks Ruka if she plans to continue working as a sexy actress, to which she answers… Ruka shows Ryosuke herself in a recruitment suit. Ryosuke puts on his own suit to show her, but unlike Ruka, it doesn't suit him at all. Just as Ryosuke is feeling down, Someya suddenly appears before him as... Section Chief?!

episodes.title: Are You Sure About It?
episodes.synopsis: It's Christmas Eve. Ryosuke invites Ruka to a fancy dinner at a hotel he'd splurged on. He makes a small blunder there, but it ends up making him respect Ruka even more. The two go straight to their room, and as they gaze at the beautiful night view, Ryosuke finally confesses his feelings to Ruka! But Ruka feels the urge to tell him something important, all the more so because he is someone so dear to her… What will become of the confession?!

episodes.title: Let's Stay Together Forever!
episodes.synopsis: Ryosuke and Ruka are now officially a couple. Ruka had, in fact, also prepared something special for today… And as the seasons turn, spring arrives with cherry blossoms in full bloom. With his final year approaching, Ryosuke is overwhelmed with anxiety about the events ahead, such as his thesis and job hunting. In contrast, Ruka doesn't seem too fazed for some reason… Here's the finale of the story about falling in love with Ms. Someya, a former adult film actress from the same seminar class!

info.title: KAMUI: He's Behind You
info.synopsis: Shizuka Mizuzuka è una studentessa delle superiori che possiede un dono insolito: può vedere i fantasmi. Questa capacità la espone continuamente a presenze inquietanti e fenomeni soprannaturali che rendono la sua quotidianità tutt'altro che normale. La svolta arriva con l'incontro con Kamui, un esorcista potente ma decisamente eccentrico. Coinvolta nelle sue attività, Shizuka diventa la sua assistente e si ritrova ad affrontare spiriti maligni e casi sempre più strani.

episodes.title: Mary-san / Teketeke
episodes.synopsis: The ringing of the phone echoes through a high-rise building late at night. The voice on the other end introduces herself as Mary-san. Shizuka is pursued by her via every phone call, no matter the room she flees to or the hallway she runs down. What encounter awaits Mary-san after cornering Shizuka?! / Teketeke a wandering spirit that seeks after its lower half of the body, lost in an accident. Shizuka, who was forced to listen to the story from Kamui, finds the ghost before her 'as promised,' unaware that this was a clever trap set up by Kamui.

episodes.title: Kokkuri-san
episodes.synopsis: Hiding her psychic ability, Shizuka hopes to enjoy school life as an ordinary student. However, her peace is shattered through her friend, Inagawa, who brings in a Kokkuri-san sheet. A spirit appears in response to Inagawa and the others' summons, and its evil grasp closes in on Shizuka. Can Kamui fulfill Shizuka's request to perform an exorcism 'secretly, without anyone seeing'?

episodes.title: The Cursed Doll / The Gap Woman
episodes.synopsis: A cursed checkered doll that keeps returning no matter how many times it's disposed of is brought into Kamui's office. The doll challenges Kamui to take her on in the purification ritual. But there, she witnesses Kamui's unimaginable lifeforce and exorcism methods firsthand. While searching for a girl who's been spirited away, Shizuka is captured by the Gap Woman. Will Kamui be able to rescue Shizuka who's trapped in a narrow gap of a building where she is out of reach?

episodes.title: The Slit-Mouthed Woman / Rokurokubi
episodes.synopsis: Shizuka is forced into a elementary school costume—tight-fitting clothes and a school backpack. As she grieves over the random punishment, the Slit-Mouthed Woman presses her, asking if she looks pretty. Shizuka flees to the empty school after classes. What is Kamui's secret plan, waiting for her in the infirmary? Kamui receives a message from Shizuka that she's going to hang out with her best friend Kyoko, and upon seeing the attached photo, he senses something. Will Shizuka be able to hide Kamui's exorcism from Kyoko?!

episodes.title: Bakeneko
episodes.synopsis: Oichi, the cursed Ichimatsu doll who was defeated in her battle against the Slit-Mouthed Woman, gets picked up by a young girl named Yui and becomes her cherished playmate. Then, a black cat that Yui had found joins them as a new playmate. But that cat was no ordinary black cat! With Yui's life and the top spot of playmate on the line, the battle between Oichi and the black cat begins!

episodes.title: The Mountain Pass Spirit / Jet Babaa
episodes.synopsis: Shizuka, who has gone for a drive with Kamui, picks up a soaking-wet woman along the mountain pass at night. Eerie handprints appear on the fogged-up windows, and the sound of the car creaking begins to echo from outside. A night of terror begins! Showing off her youth in a tight bikini as she sits in the driver's seat, Shizuka is pursued by the Jet Hag Gang—the mountain pass's supernatural menace! Oichi's driving skills and Kamui's techniques explode onto the nighttime mountain pass!

episodes.title: Hanako-san of the Toilet
episodes.synopsis: The ghostly phenomenon of the girl Hanako-san is haunting elementary schools all over Japan. Kamui and Shizuka join forces to exorcise them all at once. As their friends are exorcised one after another, the Hanako-san from all over Japan panic, and they gather at an abandoned school deep in the mountains. What is the desperate plan they have devised to turn the tide?!

episodes.title: The Succubus / Hell
episodes.synopsis: A voluptuous mother and her cute daughter visit the office from abroad. When the mother asks Kamui to exorcise the succubus possessing her, Kamui suddenly rips her clothes off! He kicks a flustered Shizuka out of the room and begins the exorcism. Will Shizuka merely stand by and watch Kamui's battle, which could potentially become an international incident?

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.synopsis: After being ambushed by a succubus and having his life force completely drained, Kamui naturally (?) falls into Hell. However, declaring that he has business to get down to, Kamui aims to return to the living world and confronts Enma the Great, who enforces the rules of the underworld. Meanwhile, in the living world, the creature Fire Cart attempts to possess Kamui's lifeless body. Will Shizuka and Oichi be able to protect Kamui's body from getting taken over?

episodes.title: Takaonna / Yamamba
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious beauty named Lily Kiskil transfers to Shizuka's school. Shizuka feels as if she's met Lily somewhere before, but Lily presses forward relentlessly. Then, a supernatural phenomenon attacks them without mercy. Shizuka, who longs for an ordinary school life but finds that the abnormal is becoming the norm, and Kamui, who has gone into training to gain greater power, cross paths in the mountains!

episodes.title: Saruyume
episodes.synopsis: After sucking out Kamui's life force, Lily somehow loses the ability to attack humans. While feeling worried as her power wanes day by day, she spends her days enjoying the lively company of Shizuka and the others. One such day, Lily decides to keep a vigil to protect Shizuka, who has been possessed by a nightmare. Meanwhile, Kamui, the one she needs most, is away from the office on other business. The curtain rises on a night spent alone between Lily, starving for spiritual energy, and Shizuka, the perfect prey for the supernaturals.

episodes.title: The Succubus Returns
episodes.synopsis: After spending the night with her friend Lily, Shizuka wakes up to find that Lily had vanished from the office. Filled with unease, Shizuka heads to school, only to discover that Lily had been erased from the memories of both teachers and students. In search of proof that Lily had ever existed, Shizuka rushes out of school. Meanwhile, Kamui gazes at the morning sun, recalling last night's battle. What was the outcome of the fight with Lily, in which they staked their very existence, their pride, and the things they could never compromise on?!

info.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
info.synopsis: Rain è un mago con un'abilità unica: può assegnare "punti di potenziamento" a qualsiasi oggetto, migliorando armi, armature e strumenti fino a renderli estremamente potenti. Per anni ha sostenuto la sua gilda rafforzando l'equipaggiamento dei compagni, ma una volta raggiunto il limite dei potenziamenti viene allontanato senza riconoscenza, considerato inutile. Ferito dal tradimento, Rain annulla tutti i potenziamenti concessi in passato e recupera un'enorme quantità di potere. Usandolo su se stesso e sui propri oggetti, scopre di poter creare equipaggiamento di livello incredibilmente alto, persino superiore a quello leggendario. Così decide di lasciarsi tutto alle spalle e iniziare una nuova vita da avventuriero, vivendo in libertà e sfruttando la sua abilità "cheat" in un mondo fantasy ricco di incontri e sfide.

episodes.title: Tutti sanno cosa si prova quando nulla va per il verso giusto, ma come reagisco io? Beh, è ​​ovvio! Scappo urlando a squarciagola!
episodes.synopsis: Rein viene cacciato dalla sua gilda perché accusato di essere inutile, così ne cerca una nuova.

episodes.title: Gli abiti potenziati che indossavo sono stati distrutti da un colpo devastante, e una ragazza traumatizzata vestita casual mi ha colpito con tutta la sua forza.
episodes.synopsis: Rein e Lily affrontano il drago faccia a faccia nonostante un grave ed evidente svantaggio.
